changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce lead_activity resource_type at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_lead_activity ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_lead_activity_resource_type CHECK (resource_type IS NULL OR resource_type IN ('LEAD', 'NOTES', 'DOCUMENTS', 'CONTACT', 'CALL_LOG', 'LENDER'))

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce lead_activity resource_action at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_lead_activity ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_lead_activity_resource_action CHECK (resource_action IS NULL OR resource_action IN ('CREATE', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'STATUS_CHANGE'))
